TITLE: Your account is secure
INTRO: Your smartphone is set up as a second factor for strong authentication.

NONE_ACTIVE.TITLE: Secure your account
NONE_ACTIVE.INTRO: Université Exemple is introducing strong authentication: as well as your password, you will need to confirm your identity using this mobile phone.
NONE_ACTIVE.MESSAGE: Your smartphone is not synchronised as a second factor for any strong authentication method.

ADD_BY_QR: I already have a QR code

TOTP.TITLE: Temporary code
TOTP.DESCRIPTION: A 6-digit code, refreshed every 30 seconds, to be entered when logging in
TOTP.ENROLL: Do you want to synchronise your smartphone to display the temporary code?
TOTP.ENROLL_OVERRIDE: A temporary code is already registered on this device. Continuing will replace it.
TOTP.ENROLL_CONFIRM: To complete the registration of this device, copy the temporary code into the OTP-Manager portal.
TOTP.INFO:
The temporary code method provides a security code that is automatically renewed every 30 seconds. The user must enter this code in addition to their password to confirm their identity.

This mechanism strengthens security by making access much more difficult for an unauthorised third party.

To activate this method, scan the QR code displayed on the strong authentication management portal.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete the temporary code?
DELETE.CONTENT: This device will no longer be synchronised for the temporary code. You will not be able to sign in with this second factor until you enrol it again.

TOTP.SECRET_HELP: It is shown below the QR code generated on your strong authentication portal
TOTP.SECRET_INVALID: Invalid secret key: only letters A to Z and digits 2 to 7 are allowed

PUSH.TITLE: Notification
PUSH.DESCRIPTION: A notification to accept or decline on your smartphone
PUSH.INFO:
Smartphone notification authentication sends a notification to the user's phone when a sign-in is attempted. The user must then approve or decline the request through the dedicated application. This process adds a layer of security by requiring explicit validation on a personal device.

To activate this method, scan the QR code displayed on the strong authentication management portal.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete notifications?
DELETE.CONTENT: This device will no longer receive authentication notifications. You will not be able to sign in with this second factor until you enrol it again.

PUSH.NAME: Account name
PUSH.SECRET_HELP: 6-digit code shown below the QR code generated on your strong authentication portal
PUSH.SECRET_INVALID: Invalid code: only digits are allowed
